The (FeCoNiCrCu1.71)96Nb4 and (FeCoNiCrCu1.71)90Nb10 HEA ingots were prepared by arc-melting high-purity metals (> 99.97%) in the Ar atmosphere, and the HEAs are abbreviated as Nb4 and Nb10 HEAs, respectively.
